collection: count[u16be] then length[u32be] and canonical element for each item
signed_body: same type/version with signature field omitted and field count decremented; full signed object includes signature as final field
strings: strict UTF-8; inherited text is nonempty, <=256 encoded bytes, no Unicode control characters

cases.name: retirement_digest
cases.canonical_source: complete u16_be(count) || (u32_be(element_length) || complete RetirementRef RFS1)* in pending_retirements order

cases.name: lease_operation_id
cases.canonical_source: complete PrekeyLeaseIntent RFS1 excluding its separately carried operation ID

cases.name: request_hash
cases.canonical_source: complete signed NativePrekeyRequest RFS1 for lease

cases.name: status_request_hash
cases.canonical_source: complete signed NativePrekeyRequest RFS1 for status

cases.name: custody_object_register
cases.canonical_source: JCS(complete register proof envelope including signature)

cases.name: custody_object_prekey_status
cases.canonical_source: JCS(complete prekey_status proof envelope including signature)

cases.name: custody_object_register_update
cases.canonical_source: JCS(complete register_update proof envelope including signature)

code_fields: Control-free UTF-8; P03-P05 typed decoders own value sets, empty values and combination semantics.
